QorCap v0.3.34: reader stall watchdog and post-final tail

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged.

- [#85](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/85): Keep the live score reader at 4 Hz when the bundle grows, and log a stall without minting a score.
- [#96](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/96): Write one stall notice when the reader fetches frames but adds no timeline or health row for 30 seconds, fail a stuck pre-sign lock closed, and cap pause progress at five minutes.
- [#82](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/82): Keep capturing for a short tail after the first committed end screen (default 10 seconds) and hash those segments on the same chain.
- [#98](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/98): Count an end screen toward the evidence cutoff when it is at or after the latest scorebug read, leave a contradicting later menu unconfirmed, and name a scorebug in the dispute note only when one sits strictly between the two menus.
- [#100](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/100): An observation, a row with no home score, or a flushed touchdown hold does not add the phrase that a scorebug came back.
- [#89](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/89): Parse challenge-alert volume and frequency so a bad value cannot drop the toast or the flash, and skip a second beep while a hung player is still running.
- [#95](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/95): Fail CI when a test file is missing from either suite list or the list command crashes, and keep a signed-zero beep volume audible.
- [#91](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/91): Re-vendor `compat.json` from QorTime `393045e`, which sets `recorder_versions.current` to 0.3.33.
